evidence.source: Operator's live sandbox QA on 2026-10-08: offer 'C7 QA 02 - Fifteen Percent' (15% in SQRATCH, stored as 1500 basis points) issued a coupon through the public POST /v1/coupon.
evidence.redaction: Only the facts below were supplied. No coupon code, customer, order or credential is stored.

conclusion: A native Percentage Off `discount` of 15 means 0.15%: the native unit is one hundredth of a percent (the same scale as SQRATCH basis points). HTTP 201 alone did not prove the percentage semantics.
stillUnverified: A live coupon created with discount 1500 shown as 15% in Commerce7 Admin and at checkout. Until that is observed, SQRATCH keeps new percentage issuance gated.
